title: Add a rule to a Satori extension library
description: Registers a named predicate a manifest can reference by ID to gate a surface. Not authorisation — Nuxeo still enforces the real permission server-side.

library.description: The extension library to add it to.

failClosed.description: Deny when unregistered rather than permit. Defaults true, inverting the platform default, because a rule you are adding now is one you want closed while it is missing.
